_source: Puppet Master spike (D:\pm-sandbox\spike\zorin\look.sh and RESULTS.md, item 5), not a Rakazo file. Only the look of Zorin OS: four plain-file packages from the official Zorin PPA (ppa:zorinos/stable, suite noble) on top of the XFCE desktop. Not Zorin's own panel, menu, session or GNOME: full Zorin was fragile in the spike and is not offered.
_pin: Without a pin apt wants to REMOVE xfdesktop4 (the PPA ships a newer xfce4-panel stack). The pin gives the whole PPA priority 100 (below Ubuntu's 500, so nothing from it replaces an Ubuntu package) and these four packages 600. The origin name of a Launchpad PPA is LP-PPA-<owner>-<name>.
_requires: xfce: the look is set through XFCE's settings. install.rs only offers it together with the XFCE desktop.
title: Zorin look
description: Makes the XFCE desktop look like Zorin OS: its light theme, icons, wallpaper and the Inter font, with the window buttons on the right and a taskbar at the bottom. Adds about 400 MB. It only changes how the desktop looks.
pre: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends software-properties-common gnupg

printf '%s\n' 'Package: *' 'Pin: release o=LP-PPA-zorinos-stable' 'Pin-Priority: 100' '' 'Package: zorin-desktop-themes zorin-icon-themes zorin-os-wallpapers-18 fonts-inter-zorin-os' 'Pin: release o=LP-PPA-zorinos-stable' 'Pin-Priority: 600' > /etc/apt/preferences.d/pm-sbx-zorin-look.pref
post: dpkg -s xfdesktop4 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: the Zorin packages removed xfdesktop4' >&2; exit 1; }
